curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Bitten and facing a terrifying transformation, can she and the hired hunter destroy the creature before her time runs out?
curatedMovie.description: In a far-future world ruled by the supernatural, a bitten young woman hires a vampire hunter to execute the creature that attacked her before an irreversible transformation takes hold.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Dark, suspenseful, and action-driven horror animation ideal for an engaged solo viewing night.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Directed by Toyoo Ashida, this 1985 anime blends dark fantasy and horror into an 80-minute quest fueled by high-stakes dread and thrilling confrontations.
